== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_92</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 92), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-92-C_3PO_See_Threepio.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-c3po-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “During a battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons, and may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent's total power. Once per game, may place all your non-Immune to Alter Effects on table in Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1210_92</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 1 set mark, slip number 92, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. The lore is the printed card's. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
